item.title: A for ACTIVIST
item.description: I would argue that climate activism has infinitely more to do with creativity than it does with freedom. Becoming an activist is at its core an act of self-creation. When you start educating yourself, you start taking responsibility for your words and your actions. Beyond the science and policies and the digital and physical campaigning climate activism requires a lot of emotional self-regulation. item.title: 3. Publisher vs. Publicist
item.description: Q. What is The Climate Change Project?The Climate Change Project is an indie publication that serves as an antidote to antiquated, uncritical, and one-dimensional climate reporting and politicking. We are in the business of investigating climate facts, interviewing climate experts, and complicating climate narratives. item.title: 15. Style Guide
item.description: ...As a publisher, I am observing without judgment and expectation. I am here to convey not to convince. My contribution, my ‘style’ is that I am a purist when it comes to information. When I listen to an interview, I am tuning in because I want to listen to the interview-ee, not the interview-er.
